items.title: Shoppers ask AI for Black Friday deals, but few let the bots pay
items.summary:
Traffic from AI services to US retail sites more than doubled on Thanksgiving from last year, Adobe told the Associated Press. Shoppers spent a record $7.1bn online that day, up 10.4%. Adobe expects $12.9bn on Black Friday itself. Purchases made by AI agents are a far smaller slice. They made up 0.4% of global e-commerce […]

items.title: How to Talk About AI at Thanksgiving
items.summary: No news day, so a different kind of episode: NLW works through 15 questions most likely to come up about AI around the Thanksgiving table. They cover jobs, cheating, kids and chatbots, water, the bubble, doom and China. Each comes with his rough take, and he argues the goal isn't to win the argument but to invite the skeptics in.

items.title: Electric cars beat petrol and diesel combined in the EU by almost 70,000
items.summary:
